name: Supareels
original_description:
Find stock footage for your videos from the chat. Supareels is a library of hand-curated, AI-generated b-roll and video overlays: light leaks, burns to white, smoke and ink transitions, flames, embers, glitter, rain, plus nature collections (beach, mountains, forest, rain, desert, meadow, waterfalls, winter). Many scenes come as matched sets, the same shot re-lit for day, sunset and night, and most come in vertical 9:16 for Reels and Shorts.

Ask for the footage you need, for example "a warm light leak overlay" or "rain at night, vertical", and Supareels shows matching clips as thumbnails right in the chat. Each opens its page on supareels.com, where the HD file downloads directly and the licence terms are set out.

Supareels is a stock library, not a video generator or editor: it finds existing clips, it does not create or edit video. Every clip is AI-generated and hand-curated, and is labelled as such. The app only reads the public catalog; it needs no account and stores nothing about your requests.
